fingerprint.domain: game production pipelines for machine-generated content
fingerprint.user: a developer shipping machine-generated quests, items and regions, at the moment a generated batch comes back and before it enters the build
fingerprint.job: know whether a generated quest chain can actually be completed, and where it breaks, without playing it
fingerprint.mechanism: a model types free-form generated content into a precondition-effect action model, then a reachability search over that model proves completability or returns the exact dead state, and the build is gated on the proof
fingerprint.buyer_or_demo: solo and small studios shipping generated quest content; demo moment is a quest chain that reads perfectly being proved impossible, with the dead state and the trace on screen

fingerprint.domain: user-generated world platforms and asset provenance
fingerprint.user: a creator on a shared-world platform, at the instant they import a file or accept a generated mesh into a world other people will walk through
fingerprint.job: attach a checkable origin to an object other people will see, without having to remember it later
fingerprint.mechanism: the origin record is minted by the system at the moment of creation and bound to the exact bytes by hash and signature, instead of being asserted by the creator afterwards
fingerprint.buyer_or_demo: the platform operator would buy it; the demo is a two-client scene where a badge is minted, seen by a second client, then a hand-edited label is caught by the hash check

fingerprint.user: a player of browser multiplayer games wanting lasting consequence, in a 5-15 minute session
fingerprint.job: feel that an action in a short session permanently changed a world other players will encounter
fingerprint.mechanism: a shared persistent world-state record accumulating player actions across sessions with model-generated faction consequences instead of a scripted event tree

fingerprint.user: a developer shipping procedurally generated content, at the moment generated content is about to enter the build
fingerprint.job: catch gameplay-breaking generated content before a player hits it without playing through it by hand
fingerprint.mechanism: a battery of structural pathfinding checks, model-based semantic review and rule-based balance checks returning a pass-fail health report

fingerprint.user: a developer shipping machine-generated quest content, reviewing a generated batch
fingerprint.job: find narrative and economy incoherence in generated game content
fingerprint.mechanism: a model reads the content specification and reports which parts do not make sense

fingerprint.user: a developer building an LLM-driven narrative game, at the moment they wire an NPC to a model
fingerprint.job: keep an AI NPC's statements consistent with what happened in the game and with established lore across sessions
fingerprint.mechanism: a persistent structured world-fact ledger with character-scoped retrieval before the call and automated contradiction checking after it

fingerprint.user: a player starting a new game
fingerprint.job: get a tutorial matched to how they actually play
fingerprint.mechanism: a model reads player behaviour and returns a tutorial sequence

name: AI asset generator for game developers

fingerprint.job: produce a usable 3D asset or sprite without an artist
fingerprint.mechanism: a model turns a text prompt or image into an asset

fingerprint.user: a player in a game scene
fingerprint.job: have the soundtrack match what is happening
fingerprint.mechanism: a model generates music that reacts to game state

fingerprint.user: a player talking to a game character
fingerprint.job: have a conversation with an NPC that is not a dialogue tree
fingerprint.mechanism: a model generates NPC dialogue in response to player text

fingerprint.user: a developer or player wanting a level quickly
fingerprint.job: get a playable level from a description
fingerprint.mechanism: a model turns a text prompt into level geometry

name: AI moderator agent that reviews each reported asset and decides with a human approving

fingerprint.user: a trust and safety moderator opening a report
fingerprint.job: decide whether a reported asset is AI-generated
fingerprint.mechanism: a model reviews the reported asset and returns a verdict for a human to approve

name: AI that inspects your world and suggests optimizations

fingerprint.user: a world or avatar creator before publishing
fingerprint.job: keep one heavy asset from degrading a shared instance for everyone
fingerprint.mechanism: a model inspects the world and returns optimisation advice

name: Catalogue retro-tagger that classifies listings and writes the tag back

fingerprint.user: an asset-store seller facing a retro-tagging deadline
fingerprint.job: tag an existing catalogue for generative-AI disclosure or lose discovery
fingerprint.mechanism: a model classifies each listing and writes a disclosure tag back to the store

fingerprint.user: a 3D or technical artist receiving a generated mesh
fingerprint.job: make a generated mesh production-ready without hours of cleanup
fingerprint.mechanism: automated retopology and cleanup of generated geometry

fingerprint.user: a mod author receiving conflict reports from players
fingerprint.mechanism: automated detection and explanation of mod conflicts

fingerprint.user: a localisation manager or LQA tester
fingerprint.job: stop shipping truncation and placeholder bugs from context-free translation
fingerprint.mechanism: show on-screen context alongside strings during translation

fingerprint.user: a QA tester triaging a player bug report
fingerprint.job: avoid re-deriving reproduction steps a reporter did not supply
fingerprint.mechanism: reconstruct reproduction steps from session telemetry

fingerprint.user: a tabletop game master preparing a session
fingerprint.job: cut hours of prep before a virtual-tabletop game
fingerprint.mechanism: generate session material from a campaign outline
